# Old National Bank: Supporting Spanish-Speaking and Latino Clients Through Accessible Banking


Share:


- Copied!


-
-
-


Hispanic Heritage Month, Sept. 15-Oct. 15, is a time for celebration, reflection, and recognition of the contributions of Hispanic and Latino Americans to the United States, honoring the rich history, culture, and achievements of the Hispanic community. This year’s theme is “Pioneers of Change: Shaping the Future Together,” which emphasizes the role of Hispanic Americans in driving progress and innovation.


As of July 1, 2024, estimates from the U.S. Census Bureau place the Hispanic and Latino population in the United States at approximately 68.1 million people, making up roughly 20% of the total U.S. population. It is the second-largest racial or ethnic group in the nation after non-Hispanic white Americans.


At Old National Bank, serving clients means understanding the unique needs of the communities where they live and work. As Latino populations continue to grow across the Midwest, Old National has expanded programs, services, and outreach efforts designed to make banking more accessible, understandable, and welcoming for Spanish-speaking customers.


### Reducing barriers, providing financial education


One of the most important ways Old National supports Latino clients is by reducing language barriers. Old National has enhanced Spanish-language capabilities within its digital banking platforms and Client Care Center, making it easier for customers to manage accounts, access information, and receive assistance in their preferred language. In addition, bilingual team members in select banking centers provide personalized guidance to help clients navigate financial decisions with confidence.


Financial education is another key focus. Through Spanish-language resources, community workshops, and the bank’s “[Dinero Inteligente](https://www.oldnational.com/about-us/community/financial-education-courses/videos-smart-money-half-minute/dinero-inteligente/) ” educational video series, Old National provides practical information on budgeting, saving, credit management, debt reduction, and other financial wellness topics. These efforts help empower individuals and families to make informed financial decisions and build long-term financial stability.


### More Spanish-tailored products and programs


Old National has also introduced products and programs designed to expand financial access. Old National has broadened the types of identification accepted when opening accounts, helping remove obstacles that some customers may face when establishing banking relationships.


Additionally, Old National launched an[ITIN Home Loan Pilot Program](https://www.oldnational.com/personal/home-loans/itin/) 1 to help eligible borrowers who do not have a Social Security number pursue homeownership opportunities. The bank’s[Empowerment Small Business Loan Program](https://www.oldnational.com/business/small-business-banking/empowermentloan/) 2 also works to improve access to capital for underserved entrepreneurs, including many Latino-owned businesses.


### Explore our resources


These efforts reflect Old National’s broader commitment to serving traditionally underserved communities. Old National continues to invest in programs, products, and community initiatives that strengthen access, opportunity, and economic growth across its footprint.


Whether you are opening your first account, exploring homeownership, starting a business, or looking for financial guidance in Spanish, visit your local Old National banking center or explore available resources at[oldnational.com](https://www.oldnational.com/) to learn how the bank can support your financial journey.


*As a courtesy, Old National Bank has translated some product information into Spanish. Please note, most communications, documents, and disclosures you will receive from Old National Bank are in English only. For account opening transactions, you are encouraged to secure your own translator. As an alternative, Old National Bank also offers interpretation services, by contacting Client Care at 1-800-731-2265.*


** *1 Subject to credit approval and customer qualification. ITIN Home Loan program offers purchase loans for owner-occupied properties. Not available for refinance loans. Not available for investment properties or secondary residences. Additional program requirements and restrictions apply. Offered for qualified properties located in the Illinois counties of: Cook, DuPage, Grundy, Kane, Kendall, Lake, and Will and the Wisconsin county of Milwaukee. Member FDIC. Equal Housing Lender. 1024-015.*


** *2. All loans subject to credit review and approval. Additional program qualifications or restrictions may apply. For full program details contact an Old National Small Business Banker.*
